Question: The number \(2013\) is expressed in the form \[2013 = \frac {a_1!a_2!\cdots a_m!}{b_1!b_2!\cdots b_n!},\] where \[a_1 \ge a_2 \ge \cdots \ge a_m\] and \[b_1 \ge b_2 \ge \cdots \ge b_n\] are positive integers and \(a_1 + b_1\) is as small as possible. What is \(|a_1 - b_1|?\)
